audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 and Levels 4-5 read 'Skill' while whys[0] and whys[3] both say he out-sustains you there, and First item / 2+ items were credited to Warwick while whys[5] and whys[6] say your AP flips the lane.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Warwick rows 0-3, Skill row 4, Vladimir rows 5-6. That matches the prose already on the page.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 3 to Warwick, rows 5 and 6 to Vladimir, ratings moved with them, proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: His sustain-led early and level 6 suppress, your first-item flip and full-AP late are all timed correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text, mid, late and wants.you[1] all claimed Sanguine Pool cast during Infinite Duress 'drops the lock' and saves you. Whether a suppressed Vladimir can cast anything is not in Riot's text, and the page was selling it as a reliable answer. No line carried a real cooldown or the percent-health detail on his Q.
audit.why: Kit file: P Eternal Hunger heals below 50% and triples below 25%; Q Jaws of the Beast 365 range / 8-6s, max-health damage plus heal; W Blood Hunt 80-40s; E Primal Howl 15-11s, damage reduction then a 1s flee; R Infinite Duress 110/90/70s, 1.5s suppress, channel. Vladimir Q and E reach 600, Pool is 2s untargetable on 28s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: The unverifiable break-the-suppress claim replaced with pre-emptive use (before the leap connects), and the 1.5s, 110s, 8s and the sub-50%/sub-25% passive thresholds written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was in itemization but nothing said when it must land, and nothing warned that his Q ignores stacked resistances.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast deals max-health damage and heals for it, and his passive healing triples under 25% — stacking armour or MR reads that trade wrong.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[1].d now carry the Grievous Wounds timing and the passive thresholds.

edits.before: His all-in suppress. Pool/dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 1.5s suppress on 110s at rank 1 — step up only once he has spent it.

edits.before: Transfusion Warwick on cooldown, E-charge behind the wave, and pool the one ability his kill plan needs.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast heals off max-health damage every 8s — buy Oblivion Orb before he drops under 50%.

edits.before: Warwick wastes Infinite Duress — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Transfusion reaches 600, his Q lunge 365 — poke and hold that gap.

edits.before: That is Warwick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s — do not be the first body it can reach.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Below 50% his passive heals; under 25% it triples. Anti-heal first.

edits.before: His R Infinite Duress is a point-blank suppress; save Sanguine Pool to break it, since pooling during the channel drops the lock and saves you.
edits.after: His R Infinite Duress suppresses you for 1.5s at point-blank on a 110s cooldown; spend Sanguine Pool before the leap connects, not after, and stay off his approach line.

edits.before: Levels 2 through 4 stay his — Q heal and steady sustain mean he wins any trade you take, and he pressures you off CS. Level 5 is skill-based as your poke finally starts biting. The big threat is level 6: R Infinite Duress suppresses you for a guaranteed combo. Hold Sanguine Pool specifically to pool out of the suppress and survive his all-in.
edits.after: Levels 2 through 4 stay his — Q heal and steady sustain mean he wins any trade you take, and he pressures you off CS. Level 5 is skill-based as your poke finally starts biting. The big threat is level 6: R Infinite Duress suppresses you for 1.5s on a 110s cooldown. Spend Sanguine Pool before the leap connects and keep off his approach line.

edits.before: The 51% win rate is a scaling flip — you eat a rough early but take over from first item on. Once your AP burst is online your E-Q rotation outpaces his Q heal, and pooling his R turns his kill attempt into a free trade for you. Kite his W chase and blow him up before Jaws heals him. Scale, survive the ult, and the lane is yours.
edits.after: The 51% win rate is a scaling flip — you eat a rough early but take over from first item on. Once your AP burst is online your E-Q rotation outpaces his Q heal, and Grievous Wounds guts the passive keeping him alive under 50%. Kite his W chase and blow him up before Jaws heals him. Scale, survive the ult, and the lane is yours.

edits.before: Save W to break his R Infinite Duress suppress
edits.after: Use W before his R Infinite Duress connects

notes: The page claimed Sanguine Pool cast during Infinite Duress breaks the suppression. Riot's text does not say whether a suppressed champion can cast Pool, so I removed the claim rather than reversing it — all four places now say to spend Pool before the leap connects, which is correct advice either way. No mirror existed; warwick__vladimir should restate these rows inverted.
